gaps.explanation: p7 (printed p20) Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints four enterprise fund columns (Electric Fund, Water Fund, Sewer Fund, Other (Trash Fund)); no enterprise schedule exists and detail[] has no business-type lines. The JSON receipts are Sales + Service charges + Other revenue + Interest income + Grant income (Total column). Per column: Electric 406,960 + 27,945 + 798 + 197 + 944 = 436,844; Water 138,878 + 33,278 + 37 + 38,672 = 210,865; Sewer 52,255 + 2,653 + 269,154 = 324,062; Other (Trash Fund) 56,282 + 2,185 = 58,467. Sum 1,030,238 = statement receipts 1,030,238. After fix: 0 + 1,030,238 = 1,030,238.
